description: The final format of a game: its released repo and its dataset. Prose: docs/game-format.md. Validator: tools/validate-game.py (repo + dataset contents) with tools/validate-dataset.ps1 (dataset layout). Severity: error = not in the format; warning = a quality rule or something to look at.

repo.what: the game's git repo at its release commit (tracked files only)

required_files.what: the project; EngineAssociation names the engine
every editor script that was run, kept unchanged
the creation record; every row matches docs/schemas/workflow-row.schema.json
hero image + captioned gallery of real gameplay stills
every external asset; matches docs/schemas/assets-manifest.schema.json, every listed file committed
Git LFS for every binary type
build output and the local dataset zip
creation replay config (ReplayScripts/ of the dataset)

banned_names.what: never inside a game: tool, vendor and owner names (text files of the repo; LFS and binary files are scanned by tools/package-game.ps1 -Rescan)
banned_names.warn_why: workflow.jsonl rows are append-only (never edited after they are written); the packager scrubs workflow.jsonl and rewrites the history (commit messages) for every delivery, so a banned name there is a warning "scrubbed at packaging", in the repo check only. The legacy row schema id "superposition.ue-workflow/v0" is accepted with the same warning.

repo.dataset_folder: Dataset/ (variant repo-dataset): checked as a dataset when manifest.json is there; a game that is not packaged yet has none

dataset.layout: docs/dataset-layout-v1.2.json for new deliveries (v1.1: docs/dataset-layout-v1.json, still valid for deliveries made before 2026-10-15); entries, names, video format, manifest keys, README sections; tools/validate-dataset.ps1 picks the file by manifest.layout
manifest: game equals the zip's top folder (full variant)
every files[] entry exists with that size (sha256 checked by validate-dataset.ps1)
totals.files = number of files[]; totals.bytes = sum of their bytes
status complete: pending empty, replay_verification.pass true, report.json verdict.pass true
variant full: build is an object; repo-dataset: build is null
commit equals the last commit in git.log and report.json final_commit
workflow: every line is one JSON object matching the row schema
a row's direction names an earlier op user.direction row
user.direction rows: actor user, reason_source user_direction, params.direction a non-empty string
v1.2: the person's directions are user.direction rows (they replace conversation transcripts); a game with none is reported as a warning
history: v1.2 full variant: manifest.history is an object; History/<game>.bundle is a git bundle whose refs include history.head = manifest.commit
the bundle holds every commit (history.commits); git.log lists the same commits
every Git LFS pointer in every commit has its object under History/lfs/objects/<aa>/<bb>/<sha256>, and each object's sha256 equals its name (history.lfs_objects / lfs_bytes count them)
author and committer of every commit are dev_NN; commit messages and text blobs carry no banned names (same scan as the repo)
brief: v1.2: Brief/brief.md (the original brief) and Brief/design.md (design doc, story bible, status) are present and non-empty; manifest.brief names them
